stem: Meena sees bees carrying pollen from flower to flower in her school garden in Jaipur. Her teacher asks: where is the male gamete of a flowering plant found?

options.text: Inside the ovule in the flower.
Inside the pollen grain in the anther.
Inside the petals of the flower.
Inside the nectar at the base of the flower.

teacher.key_rationale: In flowering plants, pollen grains formed inside the anther contain the male gametes, while ovules contain the female gametes. Option A describes the female gamete location (sibling-term trap), and C and D name non-reproductive flower parts.
